reasons.claim: The chain runs in one line from Zuhayr to Abu Hurayra, with Abu Kathir told as the one who narrated to Yahya.
reasons.quote: حدثني يحيى بن أبي كثير، أن أبا كثير، حدثه عن أبي هريرة

reasons.claim: The stored chain drops Abu Kathir, whom the text writes between Yahya and Abu Hurayra.
Mu'awiya b. Wahb and an unnamed group of companions stand at one level between al-Hasan b. Mahbub and the Imam.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Ibn Bashshar and Ibn al-Muthanna are co-transmitters from Abu Dawud, joined by «قالا».
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، وابن المثنى، قالا حدثنا أبو داود

reasons.claim: The words between dashes only gloss how each transmitter named al-Hasan b. Imran and add no link.
reasons.quote: - قال ابن بشار الشامي وقال أبو داود أبو عبد الله العسقلاني -

reasons.claim: The chain continues past al-Hasan b. Imran to the son and his father, which the stored chain omits.
reasons.quote: عن ابن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى، عن أبيه

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters both narrate from a bare «محمد», who is a link written as written.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا محمد بن المثنى، ومحمد بن بشار، عن محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة

reasons.claim: The chain ends at al-Bara' quoting the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن البراء بن عازب، قال أمرنا رسول الله

reasons.claim: Ibn Shihab is the last link, the source whose words the report relays.
reasons.quote: يقول ابن شهاب هذا حديث حمصي

reasons.claim: The stored chain's last entry is words of the report, not a name.

reviews.question: a source known only by a description, with no named transmitter («من ذكر أخبار العرب»)

reasons.claim: The report names no transmitter, only an unnamed group of those who recorded the reports of the Arabs, read as one unnamed link.

reviews.uncertainty_note: If an unnamed descriptive source is ruled no isnad, the reading becomes no_chain.

reasons.claim: The report is the compiler's own argument with no transmitter, and the stored chain's entries are fragments of his prose.
reasons.quote: قال أبو جعفر مصنف هذا الكتاب: الدليل على عصمة الامام

reviews.question: a second chain after the text joined by «بهذا الإسناد نحوه» (working rule 11)

reasons.claim: The first chain runs from Suwayd to 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, with «ثم الحبلي» a second nisba of one man.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عبد الرحمن المعافري، ثم الحبلي قال سمعت عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

reasons.claim: After the text a second route meets the first at 'Amir b. Yahya and takes the rest by back reference.
reasons.quote: حدثنا قتيبة، حدثنا ابن لهيعة، عن عامر بن يحيى، بهذا الإسناد نحوه بمعناه

reviews.uncertainty_note: If the trailing chain is ruled a remark, only the first route stands.

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes to a source with no saying

reasons.claim: The opening names the source being routed to, and the chain written after «رويته» ends at the same name.
reasons.quote: فقد رويته عن أبي- رضي اللّه عنه- عن سعد بن عبد اللّه

reasons.claim: The links are father, Sa'd, Ibrahim b. Hashim, then the source; the stored chain wrongly heads with the opening's name.
reasons.quote: عن إبراهيم بن هاشم، عن أبي عبد اللّه الخراسانيّ

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure is right if route statements are stored; otherwise the item has no chain.

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes to a source with no saying

reasons.claim: The route runs from the compiler's father to Abu Maryam in the order written.
reasons.quote: عن الحسين بن سعيد، عن فضالة بن أيّوب، عن أبان بن عثمان، عن أبي مريم

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure is right if route statements are stored; otherwise the item has no chain.
